title: נחיל המשלוחים

spec.palette: designed ramps, at most 5 steps each: canvas 5, webbing 3, ivory 2, lens 2, beacon 2, brass 2, mark 1

source: hand-placed pixels at 0 deg, every column (art/chars/weapons/w4/tools/drones_px.py); rows turned RotSprite-style (Scale2x x3, nearest), stray pixels out, the mark stamped upright after the turn, a 1 px outline
character:
WHO: a courier's cube backpack that is really a hangar: orange canvas, cream piping, two shoulder straps (he carries
       it in front of him by them, hatch forward), a tracking label with its barcode, a beacon on a stalk, a pocket
       of delivery slips; inside, three small drones waiting for an address, each with its own tracking number.
  IDLE: one drone pushes the front flap up with its head, looks ahead, looks at us, looks up, and ducks back in; the
        flap drops. FIRE: the flap is flung open, the swarm pours out one after the other, the flap swings shut and a
        delivery slip prints out of the pocket. No delivery charge.
cell_note: a bigger cell than the contract's 64: it holds the weapon at every angle with its moving parts thrown out and the toss

equip.note: 18 ticks: he swings the pack up by its straps (it lags and bumps); at tick 8 the props spin up inside: the flap rattles, a lens glows in the seam, the beacon lights; it settles, humming

idle.note: 146 ticks: the pack hangs and sways, the beacon winks; then the flap lifts: one drone puts its head out, looks ahead, turns its lens to us, looks up, and ducks back in; the flap drops, swings in a pixel, hangs

fire.note: 30 ticks = the cooldown. Tick 0 the flap is flung open and the first drone is out (the pack gives two pixels back, the strap's end flies); 2 the second, a lens already glowing behind it; 4 BUZZ: the third; then the open mouth, the flap falling, swinging in past shut; a delivery slip prints out under the pack, line by line; the beacon winks

empty.note: 12 ticks: the click: the flap opens on an empty hangar, the beacon dark; it sags, one last slip slides out; at 6 he tosses the pack away in front of him (three tumbling frames)

catch.note: the hand-off from the unarmed catch (catch.json has the body's frames): it lands in his hands by its straps, a drone looks out to see who caught it, the reveal from the last frame

aim_note: a frame's aim = degrees the weapon turns from its rest (the idle's first frame is 0), added to the body's aim; kick = [px along the barrel (negative = back), px up, degrees up]
mark: the made-in-Israel mark as a ROUNDEL sewn on the pack's side (a calm flat place of 13 x 13 px of plain canvas between the label and the pocket, under the piping): the blue interlaced outline star 9 x 9 on an ivory disc, its ring the canvas's own dark step, like a patch's stitched edge; stamped upright after the turn, whole in every row, below both fists
mark_rect_note: per angle row, per column: [x, y, w, h] of the mark in the cell (the tag with its line, or the 11 x 11 roundel) and mark_star = the top-left pixel of the 9 x 9 star; atlas_mark.png holds the mark alone in the same layout

events.draw: the pack is swung up by its straps (arsenal.json equip 0)
events.props_spin: the props spin up inside (equip 8): a rising whirr
events.ready: the act is over on this frame's last tick
events.anticipation: the 1-tick squash, on the shot's own tick (fire 0)
events.shot: the flap is flung open and the swarm leaves (fire 0): the drones are spawned at `muzzle`
events.buzz: the last one is out (fire 4): the swarm's buzz
events.click: the flap opens on an empty hangar (empty 0)
events.reveal: RENDER fires the reveal from this pose

normal_note: by plane: every colour paints one plane of the weapon (top, front, underside ...), turned with the row; silhouette pixels face out along the edge; the upright mark faces the viewer

cells: the courier drone landed, rotors still
sprites.anchor: the cell's TOP-left at `at` (frame px; the sprite stands on the cell's bottom, centred)

catch.note: the weapon's side of the unarmed set's catch, on the same ticks and hand points as the shotgun's catch.json (the body is one builder's): frames 0-2 it comes down, 3 the catch (its grip lands on the hand), 3-4 what carried it lets go, 5-6 in the hands, 7-9 held up behind his head (layer back), the reveal from 9. Its carrier is the courier drone: on the catch it lets go, then lands beside him. Frames 3 and 7-9 hold the pack slung back over his shoulder (aim -90, layer back): hanging from raised fists it would hide behind his head or cover his face.
